checks.name: exact_frozen_preparation_bindings
checks.evidence: Code/protocol/preparation/generated checks/template SHA match the root-supplied frozen preparation; prepared-only and approved-false template.

checks.name: closing_only_exclusive_writes
checks.evidence: Lexical forbidden-name and traversal guards, component nofollow source reads, ordinary-directory destinations, exclusive new writes, fixed closing subtree and fixed outside-phase output; no global README or scientific phase destination.

checks.name: typed_completed_payload_X
checks.evidence: Fixed repository/remote/main, completed all batches, no pending record, exact plan SHA, exact final payload commit, strict byte/remote proof flags and file/byte counts.

checks.name: independent_remote_exact_X
checks.evidence: Requires public/main/repository, exactly five verified files, expected and before/after main equal X, exact sealed plan, zero remote content reads.

checks.name: independent_QA_typed_assertions
checks.evidence: Unique roles, completed/PASS reports, nonempty typed field assertions, mandatory byte-roundtrip and portable-link/credential roles.

checks.name: immutable_parent_logical_and_physical_names
checks.evidence: All supplied immutable manifests cover logical paths, gzip parts and descriptors; every new destination is disjoint and existing manifests are byte-rechecked.

checks.name: source_summary_is_derived_not_model_success
checks.evidence: New source file and byte totals derive from P-root published delta records; receipt explicitly denies new training, labels, adoption and goal success. Actual 630-file totals were not independently read in this static review.

checks.name: required_nine_roles_allow_explicit_extras
checks.evidence: Required nine roles are a subset; unique roles and destination names; copied remote proof equals the authoritative remote binding; extras remain exact root-bound text.

checks.name: credential_redaction_and_portable_links
checks.evidence: Pattern diagnostics contain role/rule/count only; copied control text and portable note are scanned; note links must resolve to declared names. Independent-QA copies additionally require the root-planned full staged credential scan before push.

checks.name: payload_X_without_own_commit_cycle
checks.evidence: Receipts bind already verified payload X; future closing commit Y remains local pending, and strict closing plan starts from X.

checks.name: bounded_rehashed_closing_plan
checks.evidence: Unique files, each below 100 MiB, aggregate below 480 MiB, exact rehash, fixed main and nonexecuting plan for the existing strict push runner.

checks.name: no_Git_remote_or_model_execution
checks.evidence: Stdlib recorder and invented fixtures only; no subprocess, Git, network, model or payload execution was performed by this reviewer.

limits: Static control-flow review is not a new verification of payload X, source 630 hashes, remote main, or staged closing files.
Root must perform its declared full staged SHA/size/credential/link QA and strict local-HEAD/remote-main push guard before the separate closing push.
The helper scans main copies/control text; independent-QA JSON copies are covered by that root full-stage credential scan rather than an additional helper-local scan.
conclusion: No blocking defect found for the root-bound fresh-closing staging workflow; original payload/manifests/README and scientific phase remain immutable.
